reason: A is the better proposal because cryogenic rolling followed by annealing offers a plausible, testable route to hierarchical strengthening and extends prior processing concepts to the specified bulk lamellar alloy, although its corrosion mechanism and processing parameters need sharpening. B largely repeats the cited Y/Hf co-doping study, ambiguously mixes bulk alloying with surface cladding, and lacks sound evidence that Y/Hf will improve ductility or room-temperature creep; its cited spallation data also appear inconsistent with the claimed corrosion benefit.
